gentleman.title: Gentleman Function
gentleman.description: Move the passenger seat from the iDrive on one simple page: make room for the rear passenger, adjust the seat, two memories
gentleman.author: Evan

exhaust_flap.title: Exhaust & Start/Stop
exhaust_flap.description: Open or close the exhaust flap in every driving mode, and switch auto start/stop off (DME actuator control and routine over UDS); starts with the head unit
exhaust_flap.author: Evan

shift_lights.title: Shift Lights
shift_lights.description: BMW M-style shift lights on the instrument cluster: 6 yellow and 4 red slanted strips per side, lighting from the ends in; the whole bar turns red and flashes at the shift point. Move it and resize it on the cluster from the app. Needs the Cluster renderer tool from robertnisipeanu/idrive-apps
shift_lights.author: Evan
